title: Saray
type: Survivor of grief; Wrath’s final opponent
imageAlt: Portrait of Saray, survivor of grief and opponent of Wrath
imageCaption: Saray — survivor of grief and Wrath’s final opponent.
dek: Saray carries guilt after Nienna’s death and later lands the final blow on Wrath; the history between those moments remains deliberately open.
body:
After Nienna dies in their fight with soul eaters and wraiths on the Plains of Trial, Saray defeats the remaining enemies and brings her body to the Tower. She blames herself for the loss. Dale remains beside her without pretending that love gives him the power to decide when guilt is over.

Her care also takes a practical form. She petitions Nuru’s messenger and offers husks and gold for a diamond, then gives it to Elenia. Elenia’s Raise Dead restores Nienna on 15 July 2024. The recovery does not by itself establish how Saray’s guilt changes afterward.

The final blow

Saray later strikes the blow that defeats Wrath. That fact is consequential; the archive does not force it into a clean revenge story. The scenes connecting guilt to the battle have not yet been recovered well enough to establish that arc.

Archival boundary: guilt and the final blow are established. Motive, healing, and the full sequence between them remain open.

Akarian’s lesson with Dale

In the training account posted on 12 October 2024 (UTC), Saray urges Dale to keep his distance from their enemies. When magical control turns him against her, she attacks the source and calls for him to return to himself. Even as the fight worsens, she tells him that he is a decisive part of the war and that they need him. The pair lose the exercise; Akarian heals them and draws a lesson from the weaknesses the opponents exploited. Their defeat does not establish a death, a completed field mission, or a rupture between them.

Scenes in sequence

These selected scenes preserve what was knowable when people acted. Dates below identify source postings in UTC; they do not supply an in-world calendar. A later appearance does not settle present status.

  1. 2024-07-09 → 2024-07-15 · compatible RP

    Bringing the means for Nienna’s return

    Saray survives the Plains fight and brings Nienna’s body home, then obtains a diamond through an altar offering. Elenia uses it to cast Raise Dead and restore Nienna.

    Known at this stage
    The death and recovery of the body precede the diamond offering and successful casting.
    Consequence
    Saray’s survival, recovery work and offering belong beside Elenia’s spell in Nienna’s return.
    Still unresolved
    Saray’s guilt remains her self-assessment; the recovery does not establish that the guilt has ended.

    Receipt 1 · Receipt 2 · Receipt 3 · Receipt 4 · Receipt 5 · Receipt 6 · Receipt 7 · Receipt 8 · Receipt 9 · Receipt 10 · Receipt 11

  2. 2024-10-12 · quest

    A commitment inside the trial

    Saray accepts Dale’s proposal; Akarian directs that the rings go to Elenia.

    Known at this stage
    The characters are making commitments under the pressure of the test.
    Consequence
    The scene preserves relationship and devotion beside combat readiness.
    Still unresolved
    A decision about the rings is not a universal inheritance or ownership rule.

    Receipt 1 · Receipt 2

  3. 2024-11-21 · quest

    The final blow against Wrath

    Saray makes her last shot; the narration describes Wrath collapsing, and Scribonia observes her final blow.

    Known at this stage
    The company has suffered grievous losses and still faces immediate danger.
    Consequence
    The checked sequence preserves Saray’s decisive role without replacing the party’s contributions.
    Still unresolved
    Victory does not explain the later return of every fallen companion.

    Receipt 1 · Receipt 2 · Receipt 3

profile.personality: Saray is a decisive field adventurer whose presence becomes clearest at moments when hesitation would cost the party its opening. She contributes observation, ranged precision, and the willingness to continue through ruins, ships, storms, and tombs.
profile.achievements: Her arrow kills the giant abomination guarding the meteor orb, and she later helps investigate the reality-splitting ritual, recover Jiangshi at Gael, break Eovar’s blockade, and escape the Gael tomb. These deeds place her in several of the early campaign’s most dangerous turning points.
profile.relationships: Dale, Elenia, Quake, Gartina, Wren, Scribonia, and Adelia recur across Saray’s expeditions. Her record is that of a trusted teammate within a dense company rather than a solitary legend, with relationships made visible by coordinated action under pressure.
